// Fixture: reaching the shared datastore sideways. A cache client is not a SQL driver, but reading
// another context's keys out of Valkey is the same violation of invariant 15 with a different
// protocol — and the same bypass of the PDP.
package handler

import "github.com/valkey-io/valkey-go"

func Client(addr string) (valkey.Client, error) {
	return valkey.NewClient(valkey.ClientOption{InitAddress: []string{addr}})
}
